meta_description:
142K likes, 1,855 comments - shenaztreasury on March 7, 2026: "📌 Waves By Barberyn Welligama 

Happy Women’s Day! 🌹This video is a sign for all the women out there to pause for a moment and take care of yourself.

Your mental health matters. Your physical health matters.

Women spend so much of their lives caregiving… looking after parents, partners, kids, work, everyone else that they forget to take care of themselves.

So this Women’s Day, give yourself permission to do something just for you.

Book a spa day.
Book a massage.
Or go deeper and book an Ayurveda retreat.

This is the one I went to in Weligama, Sri Lanka called Waves By Barberyn Ayurveda Resort.

It is a beautiful Ayurvedic wellness retreat by the ocean where you get doctor consultations, herbal treatments, oil massages, yoga, meditation and personalised Ayurvedic food designed to heal your body and calm your mind. ￼

The entire place is built around medicinal trees and gardens, and the yoga pavilion looks straight out to the Indian Ocean. ￼

I came back feeling lighter, calmer and so much more connected to myself.

So if your body is tired or your mind feels overwhelmed…

take the sign.

Take a break.
Take care of yourself.

Happy Women’s Day ❤️

( WomensDay SelfCare AyurvedaRetreat SriLankaTravel Weligama WellnessTravel AyurvedaHealing SoloWomenTravel )".
